parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description:
If the ETag value that is specified in the request matches the ETag value of the object, the object is returned with an HTTP 200 OK status code. If the ETag value that is specified in the request does not match the ETag value of the object, an HTTP 412 Precondition Failed status code is returned.

The ETag value of the object is used to check whether the data has changed. You can use the ETag value to verify data integrity. Default value: null.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Account-Id
parameters.description: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Date
parameters.description: The start date of the function invocation. The format is **EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT**.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Trace-Id
parameters.description: The trace ID of the Function Compute invocation request.
